authority: FMP-11b mid-shift mode transition specification and blocked reason contract

decision.summary: Practice and Evaluation modes operate within the exact same server world identity and topology. Mid-shift mode transition is strictly blocked during an active shift to preserve trajectory integrity, unannounced incident progression, and scoring isolation. Any training mode switch requires a clean shift restart with a verified roster.

rules.rule: Both Practice and Evaluation modes must consume the existing FoundationTrainingMode enum, FoundationSimulationProfile.TrainingMode, and FoundationWorldSimulation.TrainingMode getter without duplicating enums or creating separate world branches.
In Practice mode, requested guidance responses include approved synthetic procedure hints, recommended actions, and evidence basis tags.
In Evaluation mode, procedure hint fields and step-by-step guidance are strictly excluded from client projections and responses.
Both modes assert the same server world identity (WorldId, ShiftId, 13 regions, 12 portals).
Mid-shift mode transition is unsupported and blocked without an accepted PM policy decision. Attempting a transition returns blocked and does not auto-restart or mutate the active simulation.

blockedReason: Mid-shift mode transition is blocked without an accepted PM policy decision (FMP-11b-D01). Active shift trajectory and scoring fairness require a clean shift restart.
limits: Does not invent official railway procedures or scoring rules.
Provisional synthetic guidance evidence basis only; not surveyed facility or operational acceptance.
